title: Flushing Clamp for Boat Motor – Test Water Clamp
descriptionHtml:
Flush the motor clean – easily and on land

Salt, sand and algae are hard on a boat motor's cooling system. Not rinsing the motor after a day on the water is one of the most common reasons for expensive repairs.

Connect the hose and start the motor

The flushing clamp is simply fitted over the motor's water intake and connected to the garden hose. Then you can flush the cooling system with fresh water right on land, without launching the boat at all.

Features

  • Makes it easy to rinse the motor with fresh water
  • Connects directly to a regular garden hose
  • Protects the cooling system from salt and corrosion
  • Fits most outboard motors and clamps on firmly
  • Extends the motor's lifespan

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
